name: Trinidad
author: superhac
description: A cabinet theme with an arc of wheels across the top, the playfield picture behind it and a glowing panel about the selected table.
change_log: Rebuilt for VPinFE 3.0: core now handles input, audio, preloading, the loading indicator, attract mode, turning the page for a sideways screen and the backglass and score view pages. The collection picker is core's. The page is drawn upright and fits any screen shape.
